title: Cache anonymous country, tag and genre reads at the edge

endpoints.before: Anonymous country reads always forwarded upstream, despite an existing 24-hour CDN freshness policy.
endpoints.after: After the existing anonymous-access decision, eligible GET/HEAD requests use the Worker cache with the origin's 24-hour CDN TTL. Hits avoid the origin and its per-request checks. Query strings and Origin variants remain distinct, browser/CDN freshness and CORS headers are preserved, and cookies, user authorization, session tokens and ranges bypass caching. Only shareable successful responses are stored; API-key access checks and response schemas are unchanged. Requires Worker deployment.

endpoints.before: Anonymous tag reads always forwarded upstream, despite an existing one-hour CDN freshness policy.
endpoints.after: After the existing anonymous-access decision, eligible GET/HEAD requests use the Worker cache with the origin's one-hour CDN TTL. Hits avoid the origin and its per-request checks. The group filter and all other query parameters remain in the cache key, with separate Origin variants preserving CORS. Browser/CDN freshness headers are preserved; cookies, user authorization, session tokens, ranges and non-shareable responses bypass caching. API-key access checks and response schemas are unchanged. Requires Worker deployment.

endpoints.before: Anonymous genre reads always forwarded upstream, repeating genre and localized recent-game queries despite an existing one-hour CDN freshness policy.
endpoints.after: After the existing anonymous-access decision, eligible GET/HEAD requests use the Worker cache with the origin's one-hour CDN TTL. Hits avoid the origin and its per-request checks. Locale and all other query parameters remain in the cache key, with separate Origin variants preserving CORS. Browser/CDN freshness headers are preserved; cookies, user authorization, session tokens, ranges and non-shareable responses bypass caching. API-key access checks and response schemas are unchanged. Requires Worker deployment.
